Vectorised chronic aggregation over a focal grid

Source: R/chronic.R
dot-twa_compute.Rd

Vectorised chronic aggregation over a focal grid

Usage

.twa_compute(
  df,
  focal_grid,
  tau_days,
  window_days,
  summary,
  anchor_outside_window,
  eps,
  has_imputed,
  draws
)

Arguments

df

Long chemistry with a .date column (see time_weighted_aggregate()).

focal_grid

Data frame (focal_date, site_id); one output block per row, in row order.

tau_days, window_days, summary, anchor_outside_window, eps

As in time_weighted_aggregate().

has_imputed

Logical; df carries an imputed column.

draws

Active draw domain (.draw_domain()); integer(0) for point input.

Value

NULL when nothing could be aggregated, else a data frame (r, analyte, draw, value, n_in, n_imp) ordered by focal-grid row r, then analyte (C locale), then draw.
